description: Stand up and drive multiple coordinating agents that build a feature through a filesystem relay: a driver that authors one task prompt at a time, an implementation agent (a standing poll-loop session OR a freshly spawned subagent) that implements and tests, and a shipping agent that commits, reviews, fixes, and ships - all coordinating through report files with a fixed status-line protocol and background monitors. Use when executing an approved multi-task sequence across one or more repos with separate agents that must stay in distinct lanes.
